Meera Krishnan
PGP 2025-27, Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode | meerak@iimk.edu.in

EDUCATION
PGP, IIM Kozhikode, 2025-27, CGPA 7.6/10
B.E., Electronics and Communication, PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore, 2018, 8.2/10

WORK EXPERIENCE
Mu Sigma, Bengaluru | Decision Scientist | Jul 2018 - Feb 2022
- Built a weekly demand forecasting model in R for a US retailer's 1,800 stores; forecast error (MAPE) fell from 22% to 14%
- Automated a markdown-optimisation report in SQL and Tableau used by 40 category managers
- Trained 9 new joiners on the client's data model
Career break | Mar 2022 - May 2023
Freelance Data Analyst (part-time) | Jun 2023 - Mar 2025
- Built dashboards for 3 small D2C brands on Shopify data; one brand used my cohort analysis to cut discount spend by 15%

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
ICICI Bank | Business Analytics Intern, Retail Liabilities | Apr - Jun 2026
- Built a savings-account attrition early-warning score; top-decile customers were 4.2x more likely to close the account in 90 days
- Recommended a branch call-back list for 2 regions; the bank piloted it in Chennai

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Co-lead, Analytics Club (Cognizance), IIM Kozhikode
inputs.jd_text:
Business Analyst - Customer Analytics
Kestrel Retail (Mumbai)

Kestrel Retail runs 600 grocery and fashion stores across India and a growing app business.

Responsibilities
- Build customer segmentation and churn models that drive marketing campaigns
- Partner with category and marketing teams to size opportunities and measure campaign impact
- Own weekly business reviews: KPIs, root-cause analysis and recommendations
- Write clean SQL and Python; build dashboards in Power BI

Requirements (must have)
- 2+ years of analytics experience
- Strong SQL and one of Python or R
- Experience measuring the impact of campaigns or experiments
- Ability to explain analysis to non-technical stakeholders
Nice to have: retail or banking domain experience

candidate.name: Meera
candidate.band_reason: The resume shows clear ownership, strong quantified outcomes, named tools and meaningful analytics experience across multiple settings.

must_haves.requirement: Strong SQL and one of Python or R
Experience measuring the impact of campaigns or experiments
Ability to explain analysis to non-technical stakeholders

claims.text: Built a weekly demand forecasting model in R for a US retailer's 1,800 stores; forecast error (MAPE) fell from 22% to 14%
Automated a markdown-optimisation report in SQL and Tableau used by 40 category managers
Trained 9 new joiners on the client's data model
Built dashboards for 3 small D2C brands on Shopify data; one brand used my cohort analysis to cut discount spend by 15%
Built a savings-account attrition early-warning score; top-decile customers were 4.2x more likely to close the account in 90 days
Recommended a branch call-back list for 2 regions; the bank piloted it in Chennai

concerns.detail: Career break from March 2022 to May 2023, before the freelance analyst work began.

plan.warmup_question: What topic from your first year at IIM Kozhikode has held your attention recently?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your career so far, with a focus on your last couple of roles.

slots.core_question: I see you built an attrition early-warning score at ICICI Bank. What problem were you trying to solve?
slots.intent_private: Needs Meera's specific role in framing the attrition problem, the modelling choices behind the score, how the 4.2x finding was measured, and what she would do differently now.
likely_probes: Which part of the scoring work was yours?
How did you choose the signals for the score?
What would you do differently if you built that score today?

slots.core_question: Tell me about the demand forecasting model you built at Mu Sigma.
slots.intent_private: Needs the forecasting problem, Meera's modelling decisions in R, how she contributed to the work, and how the change from 22% to 14% MAPE was established.
likely_probes: Which part of the forecasting work was yours?
Why did you choose that forecasting approach?
What was the 22% MAPE compared with?

slots.core_question: How did your co-lead role in the Analytics Club come about?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific club situation, Meera's contribution as co-lead, a people or prioritisation decision, and the resulting effect on the club's work.
likely_probes: What did you take responsibility for first?
Tell me about a decision you made with the other club leaders.
How did you know the club's work had improved?

slots.core_question: There was a career break between March 2022 and June 2023. What were you focused on during that period?
slots.intent_private: Needs a clear, comfortable account of Meera's focus during the career break and how she moved into freelance analytics afterward.
likely_probes: What was the main thing you were working toward during that period?
What did you do first when you began freelancing?
How did that period shape your approach to analytics?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritises the relevant ICICI internship and Mu Sigma modelling claims, then includes the Analytics Club leadership line because this is a final-round resume review. The career break is raised neutrally, while the strong quantified claims receive technical and measurement-focused follow-ups; the freelance work and motivation are left for live follow-up if time permits.
